transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, my family told me I needed to come in. I just... I keep telling them that I’m the reason my friend died. I didn’t call her back when I should have, and I had these ugly thoughts sometimes. It's my fault. And now I just know the Lord is punishing everybody down at the church because of me. I suppose that's why I'm here. Because of what I've done.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually high, energetic, or elated for several days?
No... no, I haven't. I don't think I've ever felt anything like that. I certainly haven't felt energetic or elated in a very long time, if ever. It's mostly just... well, just the opposite, really.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?
Yes... yes, I have. It's just this heavy feeling that doesn't ever seem to go away. From the time I wake up, I just feel so low... all day, every day. There really aren't any good days anymore.
Before this current period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt depressed like this for weeks or longer?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had sad days in the past, like anyone else, but... nothing like this. Never this heavy, and never for this long. This is the first time it's been like this.
Have you had these beliefs that your friend’s death and the problems at church are your fault only when you’ve been feeling depressed?

Yes, that's right. Before my friend passed away and I sank into all this, I never thought anything like that. I never believed the choir or the pastor were sending warnings about me. Those thoughts... they really only started after I became so low and guilty these past few weeks.
Do you have unwanted memories of your friend’s death that keep coming back into your mind?

No, not really. I mean, I think about her passing, of course, because I feel so awful about it. But it's not like... I don't have sudden flashes or memories of it popping into my head out of nowhere, if that's what you mean. I just feel guilty about it all the time.
Do you believe with complete certainty that your friend’s death was your fault?

Yes, I do. I know it for a fact. I keep telling them that I’m the reason she died. I didn’t call her back when I should have, and... well, I had ugly thoughts sometimes. I just know it's my fault. And it doesn't stop there. I know the Lord is punishing everybody at church because of me, too. I'm completely certain of it.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yes, I have. I used to do quite a bit. I loved going to choir, and my knitting circle... and bingo, too. I even liked just taking a walk through Patterson Park. But now, I just sit in my chair. None of it feels worth getting dressed for anymore.
Have you been thinking about killing yourself?
No, I haven't. I mean, I feel terrible all the time, and I know I deserve whatever punishment is coming to me... but I haven't had any thoughts about actually ending my own life. I just sit and wait.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?
No, I haven't heard anything like that. It's just my own thoughts... my own guilt. I don't hear anyone talking to me when I'm alone.
